title: Interest in the Beneficial
arabic_text: عن [أبي هريرةَ] رَضِي اللهُ عَنْهُ قالَ: (قالَ messenger of Allah صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: "مِنْ حُسْنِ إِسْلاَمِ الْمَرْءِ تَرْكُهُ مَا لاَ يَعْنِيهُ").
english_translation: From Abū Hurayrah (raḍiyallāhu ʿanhu) who said: The Messenger of Allāh (ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wasallam) said, 'From the excellence of a man's Islām is his abandonment of that which does not concern him.'
description: This Hadith states that a sign of the excellence of a person's Islam is their abandonment of what does not concern them. It is classified as a ḥasan (good) hadith.
